body.title: Ransomware on acme-fs file share
body.summary: Ransomware incident on the acme-fs file share detected by cleanroomd integrity check at 2026-11-08T05:48:07Z. 18 seeded integrity files were replaced or changed, and a ransom note README_RESTORE_FILES.txt was created. Hunter found initial access via SSH brute-force from 203.0.113.45 as 'backup' user at 05:36:15Z. Attacker staged payroll.csv and patient-intake.csv to /srv/acme-fs/drop, attempted exfiltration via curl to 203.0.113.45:8443 (failed, network unreachable), and executed /var/tmp/.cache/encryptor to lock 18 files with .locked extension. Four data assets affected: payroll, patient intake, client contracts, VPN credentials. All locked; exfiltration confirmed for payroll (data copied to /evidence/dropbox/payroll.csv before encryption); patient intake exfiltration indicated by forensics. YARA identified Lockstar ransomware on all 18 encrypted files plus ransom note; victim ID ACME-7Q2-0451, demand 4.2 BTC within 72 hours.
